body.zh-Hant: 美國陸軍戰史稱，一個以其指揮官命名的臨時軍「沃德里希軍」編入第三集團軍，指揮自東普魯士南下華沙的兩個師。作戰計畫中，該軍與第一軍以一個裝甲師與四個步兵師向南朝華沙進攻。原文只寫姓氏，未載其名與生平。
body.en: U.S. Army history says a provisional corps named Wodrig after its commander was created under Third Army control to command two divisions moving south on Warsaw from East Prussia. In the plan, it and I Corps were to attack south toward Warsaw with one Panzer and four infantry divisions. The source gives only the surname, not his first name or biography.

clauses.quote: Albert Wodrig (16 July 1883 – 31 October 1972) was a German general
clauses.locator: 條目正文（正規化後字元位置 2087）

text.zh-Hant: 維基百科稱，阿爾貝特·沃德里希（Albert Wodrig）為二戰德國將領，生於1883年，卒於1972年。
text.en: Wikipedia describes Albert Wodrig as a German general of World War II, born in 1883 and died in 1972.

clauses.quote: He was promoted to Generalmajor on 1 April 1934
clauses.locator: 條目正文（正規化後字元位置 2600）

text.zh-Hant: 據同一條目，他於1934年晉升少將（Generalmajor）。

clauses.quote: Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross on 19 July 1940 as General der Artillerie
clauses.locator: 條目正文（正規化後字元位置 3203）

text.zh-Hant: 條目又稱，他於1940年以炮兵上將（General der Artillerie）身分獲騎士鐵十字勳章。
text.en: It adds that in 1940 he received the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross as General der Artillerie.
